design.excluded: none in the final set: 70 damaged intermediate generations (runaway max-effort reasoning at the 16K/32K caps, plus timeouts) were quarantined to the dirty archive and regenerated until all 3000 cells were clean

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model
scoring.metric_revision: post-R1-5 quote-normalized metric; input normalized per R1-6

generation.provider_api: api.deepseek.com (OpenAI-compat), streaming, reasoning_content separated from text at the provider layer
generation.max_tokens: 16000 initially; raised to 32000 after 51/513 cells exhausted the budget on reasoning (see repo commit trail)

provenance: Generated via the DeepSeek API by the bench session; scored locally against the frozen human baseline; compiled eval carried into the code repo as SSOT.

normalization.why: generation hygiene flagged 23-38% title lines, moderate markdown (formatting the plain-prose human baseline lacks); remark R1-6. Scoring input = normalized text (echoed headline block dropped, markdown unwrapped, all prose preserved).
normalization.raw_text_scoring: archived: the pre-normalization eval (post-R1-5 metric) remains on the HF dataset for transparency.
